name: face click
fusion: Clicking a face (TOP, FRONT, ...) animates the camera to that standard view.

history.note: Face click goes to the right view but snaps instantly (Camera::set_view sets yaw/pitch directly). Fusion animates the camera over about 0.3 s.

notes: Face click goes to the right view but snaps instantly (Camera::set_view sets yaw/pitch directly). Fusion animates the camera over about 0.3 s.

name: edge click
fusion: Clicking one of the 12 edges animates to the 45-degree view between the two faces.

history.note: Only the 6 faces are hit-tested (viewcube() builds one quad per face). Clicking the band along an edge picks the nearest face. Fusion has 12 edge hot spots that go to the 45-degree view between two faces. StandardView has no edge or corner views.

notes: Only the 6 faces are hit-tested (viewcube() builds one quad per face). Clicking the band along an edge picks the nearest face. Fusion has 12 edge hot spots that go to the 45-degree view between two faces. StandardView has no edge or corner views.

name: corner click
fusion: Clicking one of the 8 corners animates to that isometric view.

history.note: Clicking the front-top-right corner went to TOP. Fusion has 8 corner hot spots, one isometric view each. Needs edge/corner hit zones (inset each face quad, so the outer band is edges and the corners are corners) plus arbitrary-direction views in Camera.

notes: Clicking the front-top-right corner went to TOP. Fusion has 8 corner hot spots, one isometric view each. Needs edge/corner hit zones (inset each face quad, so the outer band is edges and the corners are corners) plus arbitrary-direction views in Camera.

name: hover highlight
fusion: Hovering a face, edge or corner highlights that hot spot in blue before clicking.

history.note: Hover tints the whole face pale blue. Fusion tints only the hot spot under the pointer: the face centre, an edge strip, or a corner.

notes: Hover tints the whole face pale blue. Fusion tints only the hot spot under the pointer: the face centre, an edge strip, or a corner.

name: home button
fusion: The house icon above the cube returns to the Home view, animated.

history.note: Home icon above-left of the cube returns to home and fits, as in Fusion. It isn't animated (see face-click).

notes: Home icon above-left of the cube returns to home and fits, as in Fusion. It isn't animated (see face-click).

name: rotate arrows
fusion: With a face view active, curved arrows rotate the view 90 degrees about the view axis.

history.note: In a face view Fusion shows two curved arrows at the cube's top right that roll the view 90 degrees. FissionOxide shows only the flat face.

notes: In a face view Fusion shows two curved arrows at the cube's top right that roll the view 90 degrees. FissionOxide shows only the flat face.

name: adjacent arrows
fusion: With a face view active, triangle arrows on each side roll to the adjacent face.

history.note: In a face view Fusion shows four triangles around the face that step to the neighbouring face. FissionOxide has none.

notes: In a face view Fusion shows four triangles around the face that step to the neighbouring face. FissionOxide has none.

name: drag orbit
fusion: Dragging the cube orbits the model freely.

history.note: Dragging the cube orbits (viewcube() calls cam.orbit on drag).

notes: Dragging the cube orbits (viewcube() calls cam.orbit on drag).

name: menu
fusion: The dropdown next to the cube: Go Home, Orthographic / Perspective, Set current view as Home or Front, Reset Front.

history.note: The button under the cube only toggles orthographic/perspective. Fusion opens a menu: Go Home, Orthographic, Perspective, Perspective with Ortho Faces, Set current view as Home (Fixed distance / Fit to view), Reset Home, Set current view as Front / Top, Reset Front.

notes: The button under the cube only toggles orthographic/perspective. Fusion opens a menu: Go Home, Orthographic, Perspective, Perspective with Ortho Faces, Set current view as Home (Fixed distance / Fit to view), Reset Home, Set current view as Front / Top, Reset Front.

name: compass ring
fusion: The compass ring under the cube can be dragged to spin the view about up.

history.note: No compass ring. Fusion's ring under the cube drags to spin the view about up. Low priority.

notes: No compass ring. Fusion's ring under the cube drags to spin the view about up. Low priority.

name: fade when idle
fusion: The cube is translucent until the pointer approaches.

history.note: Cube is always fully opaque. Fusion's cube is semi-transparent until the pointer comes near.

notes: Cube is always fully opaque. Fusion's cube is semi-transparent until the pointer comes near.

name: axis triad
fusion: A small XYZ triad sits at the cube's lower-left corner.

history.note: Lettered X/Y/Z stubs leave the cube's silhouette, as in Fusion.

notes: Lettered X/Y/Z stubs leave the cube's silhouette, as in Fusion.

name: orbit
fusion: The bottom navigation bar has Orbit (free / constrained), Look At, Pan, Zoom, Fit.

history.note: Orbit, Look At, Pan, Zoom and Fit are there, but the carets after Orbit and Fit are just drawn (nav_caret, Sense::hover). Fusion's Orbit caret picks Free Orbit or Constrained Orbit, and the Zoom caret offers Zoom Window and Fit.

notes: Orbit, Look At, Pan, Zoom and Fit are there, but the carets after Orbit and Fit are just drawn (nav_caret, Sense::hover). Fusion's Orbit caret picks Free Orbit or Constrained Orbit, and the Zoom caret offers Zoom Window and Fit.

name: display settings
fusion: Display Settings flyout: visual style, environment, effects, object visibility, camera, ground plane.

history.note: Has 2 of Fusion's 7 visual styles (Shaded, Shaded with Visible Edges Only), Ortho/Perspective, ViewCube and GPU toggles. Missing: Shaded with Hidden Edges, Wireframe x3, Environment, Effects (shadows, reflections, ground plane), Object Visibility submenu (origins, sketches, joints, construction), Perspective with Ortho Faces, Full Screen.

notes: Has 2 of Fusion's 7 visual styles (Shaded, Shaded with Visible Edges Only), Ortho/Perspective, ViewCube and GPU toggles. Missing: Shaded with Hidden Edges, Wireframe x3, Environment, Effects (shadows, reflections, ground plane), Object Visibility submenu (origins, sketches, joints, construction), Perspective with Ortho Faces, Full Screen.

name: grid snaps
fusion: Grid and Snaps flyout: layout grid, snap to grid, grid settings, incremental move.

history.note: Has Layout Grid and Snap to Grid. Missing: Layout Grid Lock, Grid Settings (adaptive/fixed spacing), Incremental Move, Set Increments.

notes: Has Layout Grid and Snap to Grid. Missing: Layout Grid Lock, Grid Settings (adaptive/fixed spacing), Incremental Move, Set Increments.

name: viewports
fusion: Viewports flyout: single / multiple views.

history.note: The Viewports flyout has one inert 'Single View' item. Fusion offers Single View and Multiple Views (4 linked viewports).

notes: The Viewports flyout has one inert 'Single View' item. Fusion offers Single View and Multiple Views (4 linked viewports).

name: look at
fusion: Look At, then a face, rotates the camera normal to it.

history.note: Look At aligns to the sketch plane or a selected planar face (App::look_at_selection).

notes: Look At aligns to the sketch plane or a selected planar face (App::look_at_selection).

name: hover face
fusion: Hovering a face highlights it (blue tint) before any click.

name: hover edge
fusion: Hovering an edge thickens and highlights it.

name: hover vertex
fusion: Hovering a vertex shows a point highlight.

name: hover sketch
fusion: Hovering a sketch curve highlights it; profiles highlight on hover when a command wants a profile.

name: click select
fusion: Click selects; selected entities draw in a stronger blue than hover.

name: ctrl shift select
fusion: Ctrl or Shift+click adds to or removes from the selection.

name: window select
fusion: Left-to-right drag is window select, right-to-left is crossing select, with different box styles.

name: select other
fusion: Press and hold the left button shows Select Other, a list of the entities under the pointer.

name: middle pan
fusion: Middle drag pans; Shift+middle drag orbits; the wheel zooms toward the pointer.

name: double click loop
fusion: Double-clicking an edge selects its tangent chain or loop.

name: origin planes
fusion: Commands that need a plane show the origin planes as translucent squares that highlight on hover.

name: tooltip on hover
fusion: Hovering an entity during a command shows a small context tooltip (Select a plane or planar face).

name: empty click clears
fusion: Clicking empty space clears the selection.

name: escape clears
fusion: Escape cancels the command, then clears the selection.

name: ring
fusion: Right-click opens an 8-slot ring: Repeat, Delete, Press Pull, Redo, Hole, Sketch, Move/Copy, Undo.

name: overflow
fusion: A list under the ring: OK/Cancel, Pan, Zoom, Orbit options, Show All, Workspace, recent commands with shortcuts.

name: context aware
fusion: Ring and list change for faces, edges, bodies, sketches and browser items.

name: flick
fusion: Right-drag in a direction runs that slot without waiting for the menu (marking gesture).

name: hover preview
fusion: Hovering a slot highlights it and shows the command's tooltip.

name: workspace switcher
fusion: Workspace dropdown at the left (Design, Generative, Render, ...).

name: tabs
fusion: Tabs per workspace: SOLID, SURFACE, MESH, SHEET METAL, PLASTIC, UTILITIES, MANAGE, TOOLS.

name: panel dropdowns
fusion: Each panel name (CREATE, MODIFY, ...) opens a dropdown with every command.

name: pin to toolbar
fusion: Commands in dropdowns can be pinned to the panel or the toolbar.

name: rich tooltip
fusion: Hovering a command shows a tooltip; resting longer expands it with an illustration and description.

name: contextual tab
fusion: Entering a sketch switches to a SKETCH tab with FINISH SKETCH at the right.

name: qat
fusion: Quick access toolbar: data panel, File menu, Save, Undo, Redo.

name: tree
fusion: Browser tree: document settings, named views, origin, bodies, sketches, components.

name: eye toggle
fusion: Each node has a visibility eye that toggles on click.

name: hover highlight
fusion: Hovering a browser node highlights the entity in the canvas.

name: context menu
fusion: Right-click on a node gives a node-specific menu (Rename, Delete, Create Components from Bodies, ...).

name: rename dblclick
fusion: Double-click or slow-click a name to rename it in place.

name: drag reorder
fusion: Bodies and components can be dragged between folders and components.

name: activate component
fusion: The radio button next to a component activates it.

name: collapse
fusion: The browser panel collapses to a narrow strip and can be pinned.

name: icons
fusion: Each feature is an icon in the timeline at the bottom; hovering highlights the feature in the canvas.

name: dblclick edit
fusion: Double-clicking an icon reopens the feature's dialog.

name: rollback marker
fusion: Dragging the marker rolls the model back; features after it grey out.

name: drag reorder
fusion: Dragging an icon reorders features, with a red line where it can't go.

name: context menu
fusion: Right-click: Edit Feature, Edit Profile Sketch, Suppress, Delete, Roll History Marker Here, Create Group.

name: playback
fusion: Playback buttons: to beginning, step back, play, step forward, to end.

name: error badges
fusion: Failed features turn red or yellow with a warning tooltip.

name: heads up input
fusion: Drawing a line or rectangle shows length and angle boxes that follow the cursor; Tab cycles them.

name: inference lines
fusion: Dotted inference lines snap to horizontal, vertical and other points.

name: constraint glyphs
fusion: Constraints draw as glyphs next to geometry; hovering a glyph highlights the constrained items.

name: dimension leaders
fusion: Dimensions draw with extension lines, arrows and the value; double-click edits the value.

name: fully constrained color
fusion: Fully constrained curves turn black; underconstrained curves stay blue.

name: sketch palette
fusion: Sketch Palette: Options (look at, grid, snap, slice, profile, points, dimensions, constraints) and Finish Sketch.

name: drag geometry
fusion: Dragging underconstrained geometry moves it live while constraints hold.

name: profile shading
fusion: Closed profiles shade light orange.

name: finish returns view
fusion: Finish Sketch animates the camera back to the view before the sketch.

name: command dialog
fusion: Feature dialogs dock top-right of the canvas with OK/Cancel, a collapsible header and a help icon.

name: selection rows
fusion: Selection rows show a count (1 selected) with an X to clear and a blue arrow when active.

name: live preview
fusion: Features preview live while the dialog is open.

name: manipulators
fusion: Arrows and rotation handles in the canvas drag values (extrude distance, fillet radius).

name: value expressions
fusion: Value boxes take expressions and units (10 mm + 2 in, d1 * 2).

name: enter ok
fusion: Enter commits, Escape cancels.

name: s toolbox
fusion: S opens Design Shortcuts: recent commands plus a search box.

name: keys
fusion: Single keys: E extrude, F fillet, Q press pull, H hole, D dimension, L line, R rectangle, C circle, M move, J joint, I measure, X construction, V visibility.

name: customize
fusion: Shortcuts can be reassigned from each command's ... menu.

name: data panel
fusion: Data panel (grid icon) slides in with projects and files.

name: document tabs
fusion: Document tabs across the top, with + for a new design.

name: notifications
fusion: Job status, notification bell, help and profile at the top right.

name: status bar
fusion: Selection info such as 1 Profile | Area: 2.00 in^2 at the lower right.

name: text commands
fusion: Text Commands panel at the bottom.

name: comments
fusion: Comments panel at the lower left.

name: open forwarded file
fusion: Opening a file while the app is running brings the window forward and shows the model right away.

history.note: Single-instance forwarding works (file opens in the running window, title changes), but the body is not drawn: the canvas shows only axes and grid until Body1's visibility is toggled. F6 and Home don't help. The CLI renders the same .fox correctly, so the GUI isn't building meshes for a document opened through the forwarded path.

notes: Single-instance forwarding works (file opens in the running window, title changes), but the body is not drawn: the canvas shows only axes and grid until Body1's visibility is toggled. F6 and Home don't help. The CLI renders the same .fox correctly, so the GUI isn't building meshes for a document opened through the forwarded path.

name: up axis
fusion: Default up axis is Y in Fusion here (ViewCube TOP faces +Y), with a Preferences option for Z up.

history.note: FissionOxide is Z-up with no visible preference. Fine as a default if a Y-up option exists; check Preferences.

notes: FissionOxide is Z-up with no visible preference. Fine as a default if a Y-up option exists; check Preferences.

name: no phantom saves
fusion: Fusion only adds a Data panel entry when the user saves; unsaved untitled designs never appear there.

history.note: The hub has 117 items, almost all empty 'Untitled' designs (0 features, origin 'saved', 193-byte .fox). Overnight they appeared at 02:53, 02:56, 02:57, 03:01 (x4), 03:06, 03:07, 03:08 and 03:09, each logged as 'created Untitled'. Not caused by idling (90 s, none), a click on the canvas, launching a second instance, or fissionoxide-cli info/render. Some UI path is calling hub.save (data_panel.rs:933) on an empty untitled design; it lines up with the window being activated or a file being forwarded. Fix the trigger, and don't hub.save an empty, unnamed design without the user asking.
